mechanism: delegate/sub-agent tool unavailable on this pod → fallback: 10 parallel terminal worker jobs. Each = `setsid nohup timeout -k 30 18000 python3 /tmp/orch/worker.py SAn` (own process group, hard 5 h cap) reading its scoped brief (/tmp/orch/briefs/SAn.json) and executing queued steps (bash/python/Playwright via a process-group wrapper with a hard per-step cap), ISO-8601 UTC logs. Workers are scripted jobs, not LLM agents; the lead authored the steps, generated/judged images through the OnDemand MCP plugins and made all code decisions.
model_requested_for_subagents: Sonnet 5.5 — not available to terminal jobs; used as the relay endpoint (predefined-claude-sonnet-5.5) for every OnDemand plugin session (GPT Image 2.5 generation/edit, Gemini vision judging)
